description: The record of one tested build, in one lite record call. Test freely with the app, the API, and the docs. Then record the full build. A build has one record. When Checkmate refuses, read reason and hint, correct the payload, and send it again. Only the PM answers questions and accepts records.

items.description: New rules that you found during the test and that no item covers. Leave out this field when you have none.

checks.description: Give each item one or more checks on each build. For a regression item, do the baseline steps again exactly. For each rule, also try the boundary value, the other entry point (API or UI), the state after an undo or a removal, and a second view of the same value (a list, an export, a header).

defects.description: The new defects of this build, each with a new ID. Give an earlier defect a verdict in retests. Do not record it again. A failed check must name each defect. When no item covers a defect, add an item and a failed check. Leave out this field when you have none.

retests.description: A verdict for each open earlier defect. Do the steps of each open defect again before you explore.

questions.description: New questions about points that are still not settled. Do not ask a question again. Leave out this field when you have none.

evidence.description: File paths relative to the workspace, for example evidence/r1.png, or {"text": "<what you saw>"}. Save screenshots, responses, and logs as files.

id.description: A new unique item ID, for example R9.

source.description: Where the rule comes from: exploration, or docs/<file>#<section>.

item.description: The ID of the item that this check verifies.

check.description: What you did, in one sentence. For a regression item, give the baseline steps.

result.description: passed or failed when the check ran. blocked when it cannot run. not_run when you did not run it. A criterion item needs passed, failed, or blocked.

observed.description: What you saw. Necessary for passed and failed.

value.description: Necessary for a regression item: the value after the baseline steps, in the form of the baseline. A different value is a failure, unless the ticket or a PM answer changes the rule. Then give the cause in reason.

reason.description: Necessary for blocked and not_run: why the check did not run. On a passed regression check with a new value: why the new value is correct.

defect.description: Necessary on a failed check, and only there: the ID of a defect in defects, or of an open earlier defect with the verdict not_fixed.

id.description: A new defect ID, for example D1.

title.description: A short title that names the incorrect behaviour.

steps.description: The exact steps that show the defect, one step in each entry.

expected.description: The correct result, and the ticket, doc, or PM answer that states it.

evidence.description: Necessary: one or more entries that show the incorrect result: a screenshot, a response body, or a log. Use the form of checks[].evidence.

defect.description: The ID of the open earlier defect.

verdict.description: fixed or not_fixed. For not_fixed, also add a failed check that names this ID in defect.

observed.description: What you saw when you did the steps of the defect again.

evidence.description: Necessary: one or more entries that show the result on this build.

id.description: A new question ID, for example Q1.

question.description: One clear question for the PM.

items.description: The IDs of the items that the answer changes.
